text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's running the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) too~!? Ughhh~~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"I know I shouldn't be saying this while 
on the job, but man, I really want Narita 
Brian to take it!"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I know, right?! You just want her 
to keep winning non-stop and become the 
strongest Umamusume ever!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!? Biwa Hayahide-san!? You are 
Biwa Hayahide-san, right!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... that is the case, but.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I used to be a huge fan of yours! 
Are you here to cheer for your little 
sister today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Well, that's about the size of it.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Then let's cheer them on together! Even 
though Hayahide-san's injury was 
unfortunate...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Show some respect! Don't bring up the 
injury!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No. It is a fact that I was injured. And 
because of that, I haven't been able to 
run in races.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! If it's your little sister, 
she'll carry that regret with her and win 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My regrets, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). The stage where 
racers contend for the historic Spring 
Shield. As for how Narita Brian is 
doing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is, what I have 
to do doesn't change.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today features "Japan's pinnacle 
stayer" Mejiro McQueen and the "Double 
Crown Umamusume" Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to look at me with such 
expectant eyes; the results will speak for 
themselves...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Do your best, McQueen! Go for it! 
We're rooting for you, Bourbon!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's quite lively here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you're finally here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us run a good race today. So neither 
of us has any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recognizing shared status parameter 
between you and me: 『Thirst for 
Victory』.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Though what we wish to grasp in the end 
may differ, the fact that we cannot afford 
to lose remains the same.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You are Umamusume who have honed 
yourselves through racing and continually 
proven your worth to the world.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to use you all to prove 
myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If only to calm this flush, this aching 
throbbing...!
